==Description==
'''Krampus''' appeared exclusively in [[Village of Despair]] as the final boss of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. As with most major bosses, it had an extremely high amount of health, but walked very slowly.

'''Krampus''' had five abilities. Its ''Stomp'' attack created a large shockwave, stunning towers around it. Its ''Summon'' ability summoned a large number of enemies. These enemies could have been the [[Frozen (Village of Despair)|Frozen]], [[Gingerbread (Village of Despair)|Gingerbread]], [[Burnt Gingerbread]], [[Snowman (Village of Despair)|Snowman]], [[Deep Freeze (Village of Despair)|Deep Freeze]] and [[Yeti (Village of Despair)|Yeti]]. Its ''Crystallize'' attack created a line of ice that froze towers for a long time so that they could not attack. When '''Krampus''' reached half health, it would activate its ''Rage Mode'', healing itself. During this attack, it was immune to most attacks for about 15 seconds, excluding [[Units|unit]] collision damage. It then gained the ''Icicle Storm'' attack, which caused icicles to fall around the map, freezing most, if not all, towers.

==Appearance==
'''Krampus'''' appearance resembled an ice warrior as it wore dark blue granite robes to symbolize the cold. It had blue skin, had two large pauldrons and wore a large ice helmet, complete with horns. It also wore black granite shoes. It had light blue glowing eyes. It initially spawned with an ice staff on its back, but few seconds after spawning it would take out its ice staff, which would be used to perform many of its abilities. The staff emitted white light when wielded, however, it would not emit light if it was on '''Krampus'''' back.

During ''Rage Mode'', '''Krampus''' would briefly emit blue sparks. It would take off its helmet, revealing its head. Its eyes changed from light blue to blue. The skin turned from dark blue to black with blue parts. '''Krampus''' also emitted blue light, instead of white light that was emitted from its ice staff.

==Strategy==
*The [[Medic]]'s ability is very useful against this boss due to the fact that most of its attacks stun towers for a long while. The ability can cleanse towers of their stun.
**This is best taken advantage of by having a spare tower slot for the [[Medic]], ready to place down whenever towers are stunned.
*As always, [[Ranger|Outlaws]], [[Minigunner]]s and [[Turret]]s are the best towers against this boss due to their high DPS.
**The [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the range of these towers. This is recommended due to the map layout and the fact that most of '''Krampus'''' attacks stun towers near its vicinity.
**The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the firerate of these towers. This is recommanded heavily with [[Ranger|Outlaws]] due to their mostly high firerate.
*If '''Krampus''' passes the bridge, sell towers on the first island and place them near the end.
*A few [[Rocketeer]]s may be useful in killing the enemies that '''Krampus''' spawns.
*You cannot slow this boss down by any means, such as the [[Freezer]] or [[Pyromancer]].
**The [[Pyromancer]] will deal non-burn damage to it, but it cannot burn it.
**Likewise, the [[Freezer]] can deal damage to it, but it cannot freeze it.
***In both cases, it is best to just sell these towers and place down another tower that has high DPS.
*'''Krampus''' debuts with four [[Frost Hero (Village of Despair)|Frost Heroes]] spawning in front of it, which can easily stun the majority of your towers.

==Trivia==
*In folklore, Krampus is half-goat, half-demon. During the Christmas season, he punishes children who have misbehaved.
**Krampus originated from Germany.
*Krampus may be loosely based on [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Frosty|Frosty]], in terms of design, from ''Tower Battles''.
*The shoulder pauldrons on ''Krampus''' were a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|4375946079|Left Pauldron of the Void}} and the {{RLinkC|4472201333|Right Pauldron of the Void}} accessories from the Roblox catalog.
*The horns worn by Krampus are a re-textured and resized version of the {{RLinkC|3980856807|Ram Horns}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*This was the first boss to have a ''Rage Mode'' ability (the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]'s ''Rage Mode'' was added after '''Krampus''').
**This is, so far, the only enemy with a unique ''Rage Mode'' theme.
***When '''Krampus''' activated its ''Rage Mode'', '''Krampus''' puts its ice staff behind its back, then an ice blue aura and snowflake particles can be seen around its torso. '''Krampus''' took off its mask, revealing its face.
*When the [[Christmas 2019 Event]] ended, '''Krampus'''' helmet could be found in the lobby on the beach.
*'''Krampus'''' head was the {{RLinkC|4173817682|The Scorched}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
*'''Krampus''' would always use its ''Stomp'' ability and then a second random ability few seconds after spawning.
**Additionally, it would always use its ''Icicle Storm'' ability after its ''Rage Mode''.
*'''Krampus''' came back in the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]] to take revenge, receiving visual improvements and similar abilities.
